stemMarkdown: Evaluate $\dfrac{1}{5 + \sqrt{13}}$ as a decimal. (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate $5 - \sqrt{13}$: $\dfrac{5 - \sqrt{13}}{5^2 - 13} = \dfrac{5 - \sqrt{13}}{12} = 0.116204$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Rationalising does not change the value — it just moves the irrational part to the numerator.
